text:
anna.dev: Heads-up — our Windows sample app (Py 3.10/3.11/3.12) is intermittently failing TLS when using the python SDK async client. Error shows `ssl.SSLError` on connect and then later `TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable` in the retry loop. Anyone seen this?

mike: Can you paste the stacktrace + the minimal repro?

anna.dev: Stack (snip):
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "run.py", line 23, in <module>
    asyncio.run(main())
  File ".../asyncio/runners.py", line 44, in run
  File "site-packages/redwood_sdk/async_client.py", line 128, in _request
    for h in resp.headers:
TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
  File "site-packages/ssl.py", line 1040, in wrap_socket
ssl.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate (_ssl.c:1123)
```

jess: Windows+Python cert handling is weird — on mac/linux we rely on certifi, on Windows the OS store is used. Are you using virtualenv vs system?

anna.dev: Repro steps: clean venv, pip install redwood-sdk==0.9.3, pip install aiohttp, run with stock python.org installer 3.11 on Win10. Happens ~30% of runs.

kevin: I think this is a regression introduced when we switched to using `ssl.create_default_context()` without explicitly loading certifi bundle in the async path. Sync client loads certifi in init, async client path missed it.

mike: That would explain the cert error. The TypeError in retry loop sounds like we swallow the httpx/aiohttp response on failure and later assume headers exist. Bug: retry handler returns None but caller expects Response.

jess: Also seeing complaints in GH issues about missing typing for AsyncClient — users on 3.8/3.9 get poor autocomplete because we don't export proper overloads for sync vs async. We should add `typing_overloads.pyi` or real overloads.

anna.dev: Workaround that helped me: `pip install certifi` and set env before running: `set SSL_CERT_FILE=%PYTHON_HOME%\\Lib\\site-packages\\certifi\\cacert.pem` then runs succeed. Not ideal.

kevin: Agree not ideal. Plan: (1) ensure async client imports certifi and calls `context.load_verify_locations(certifi.where())` when creating SSLContext on Windows; (2) fix retry to always raise a HTTPError on fatal failures instead of returning None; (3) add typing stubs/overloads for AsyncClient to improve IDE support.

mike: I can open a PR with (2) + a test that simulates aiohttp returning None and assert our retry raises. Anyone willing to do the certifi import change?

jess: I'll take the typing work — will prototype a small `py.typed` + `__init__.pyi` for top-level exports so `from redwood_sdk import AsyncClient` gets proper signatures. That should cover 3.8->3.12.

anna.dev: Thanks. For the immediate unblock, I pushed a tiny local patch to our sample app to explicitly `import certifi; context.load_verify_locations(certifi.where())` before creating the client and it stabilized.

devex-bot: Issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/2345 — "windows: async client misses certifi, causes intermittent TLS + retry TypeError" :white_check_mark:

kevin: cc @eng-runtime in case there are interactions with the new TLS kernel optimizations. Also we should document the Windows note in the onboarding sample app until patched.

mike: PR opened for retry behavior: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2360 — adds unit test + fixes None path.

jess: Typing draft PR incoming shortly. I'll add CI on 3.8/3.9/3.10/3.11/3.12 on Windows GitHub Actions matrix to catch regressions.

anna.dev: Great — can we get a patch release (0.9.4) after those land? Our internal infra wants a pinned release.

deploy-bot: Canary package 0.9.4-rc1 pushed to artifactory: https://packages.redwood.ai/redwood-sdk/0.9.4-rc1

kevin: We'll try to move fast. Thanks for the clear repro, @anna.dev. Keep the sample app updated — that saved time. :rocket:

anna.dev: Will update the sample in `examples/windows-async` with the certifi workaround and link to the issue.

mike: closing loop here — I'll coordinate back once PRs merged and we cut the patch.

jess: noted — will add typing changelog entry and compatibility notes for Windows/3.12.

anna.dev: Thanks everyone!
